The core of the composition will be a meticulously drawn front elevation of the building, placed centrally on a piece of aged, cream-colored paper. Behind this elevation, incorporate a clean, delicate line-art rendering of the surrounding natural landscape of ${location}, capturing the unique terrain features and vegetation.

Around the perimeter of the main elevation, include 2â3 rectangular detail boxes that zoom in on specific architectural elements, such as the intricate masonry work, the keystone arches, or the weathered wooden shutters. Each detail box should be framed with a thin, ruled border and contain a caption that is clearly legible, such as "Detail of West FaÃ§ade â Mortar Joints" or "Detail of Entrance Portal â Hardware".

The main elevation should be annotated with dimension lines that radiate out from key points of the structure. Use a consistent font style for the dimensions, ensuring it is easy to read against the warm tonality of the paper. Assign specific dimension values to give the piece a sense of scale and authenticity; for example, "Height of Central Spire: ${height_value_1} feet" and "Width of Grand Entrance Arcade: ${height_value_2} meters".
